topics.title: Stern’s Morning Technical Mishaps
topics.summary: Howard Stern discusses technical issues with his co-hosts including a misprinted video box and industry buzzwords like ‘Chiron,’ ‘ISO,’ and ‘lay-in.’ They engage in lighthearted banter about their appearances, take calls from listeners discussing the video, and offer opinions on the hosts’ looks. 54 words.

topics.title: Tape Mishap & Caller Queries
topics.summary: During the broadcast, callers discussed issues with a recently ordered video tape featuring Gary, including incorrect box art and missing footage. Several callers inquired about delivery delays due to mailing processes, highlighting that some received early copies with errors.

topics.title: Young Americans and Prenuptial Agreements - Radio Chatter
topics.summary: The broadcast centers on a discussion about young women marrying wealthy men with an emphasis on skepticism regarding their motives. Guests critique a recent music video featuring Chris Everett Lloyd, describing him as "a piss head" and "ultra liberal," while also discussing weight loss strategies and the perceived value of watching new music videos.

topics.title: Ribs and Racial Discussions
topics.summary: During a studio recording, hosts engage in rapid-fire questions about race relations and Jimmy J. Walker’s book while focusing on the appearance of a guest, discussing her ribs and body shape. The conversation veers into discussions regarding education, celebrity appearances, and personal opinions without addressing specific solutions or claims.

topics.title: Pro-Choice Rallies and Political Debate
topics.summary: Yesterday saw widespread pro-choice rallies across numerous cities including Washington D.C., New Orleans, Los Angeles, with prominent figures like Goldie Hawn and Jesse Jackson speaking out in support of women’s reproductive rights. The demonstrations aimed to pressure politicians regarding abortion legislation while highlighting personal experiences related to the issue.

topics.title: East German Tourists Flood West Germany
topics.summary: Following the Berlin Wall’s fall, East Germans flocked to West Germany seeking economic opportunities and one-time payments of 100 marks. Banks were overwhelmed with people lining up for cash, particularly families including young children, creating immediate challenges for West Germany's economy due to increased spending.
